title: 33rd Rescue Squadron
description: The 33rd rescue squadron demonstrated their humanitarian relief abilities as part of a cultural exchange on Kadena Air Base. Cpl Tyler Mitchell takes us to the demonstration where children from the Fukashima incident watched in awe.
keywords: 33rd Rescue Squadron, AFN Okinawa, Fukushima Outreach
